key: BENNETT: Our mark has gotten quite cozy up there.
en: BENNETT: Our mark has gotten quite cozy up there.
ja: ベネット: ターゲットは、あそこですっかりくつろいでいるようだね。

key: SERRA: I don't think there's any way to reach it, is there?
en: SERRA: I don't think there's any way to reach it, is there?
ja: セラ: あそこに手が届く方法なんて、ないんじゃないかしら?

key: BENNETT: Reaching it would be pointless.
en: BENNETT: Reaching it would be pointless.
ja: ベネット: 手を伸ばしたところで無意味だよ。

key: It would just run away again anyway...
en: It would just run away again anyway...
ja: どのみち、また逃げてしまうだろうし…

key: We need a different approach.
en: We need a different approach.
ja: 別のアプローチが必要だ。

key: SERRA: Between the three of us, maybe we could corner it.
en: SERRA: Between the three of us, maybe we could corner it.
ja: セラ: わたしたち三人がかりなら、追い詰められるかもしれないわね。

key: BENNETT: This place must've been used as a camp.
en: BENNETT: This place must've been used as a camp.
ja: ベネット: ここは野営地として使われていたに違いない。

key: Look, among the stones-- a stirring spoon.
en: Look, among the stones-- a stirring spoon.
ja: 見て、石の中に――かき混ぜ用のスプーンがある。

key: SERRA: Aren't we still in a New World?
en: SERRA: Aren't we still in a New World?
ja: セラ: まだニューワールドの中じゃなかったかしら?

key: BENNETT: Considering the ecology, I assume not.
en: BENNETT: Considering the ecology, I assume not.
ja: ベネット: 生態系を考えると、そうではないと思う。

key: The generated world must have connected to both Victory Road and this previously isolated cave.
en: The generated world must have connected to both Victory Road and this previously isolated cave.
ja: 生成された世界は、チャンピオンロードと、以前は隔絶されていたこの洞窟の両方につながったに違いない。

key: This camp was probably left behind by a hiker sometime ago, suggesting that it's impractical-- rather than impossible-- to get here by foot.
en: This camp was probably left behind by a hiker sometime ago, suggesting that it's impractical-- rather than impossible-- to get here by foot.
ja: この野営地は、以前ハイカーが残していったものだろう。徒歩でここまで来るのは不可能というより非現実的だということを示唆している。

key: SERRA: Well that's nice, but it doesn't exactly help us with Victini.
en: SERRA: Well that's nice, but it doesn't exactly help us with Victini.
ja: セラ: それは結構だけど、ビクティニの件には特に役立たないわね。

key: BENNETT: No, I believe it does.
en: BENNETT: No, I believe it does.
ja: ベネット: いや、役立つと思うよ。

key: This camp has seen a healthy share of use.
en: This camp has seen a healthy share of use.
ja: この野営地はかなり使われてきた形跡がある。

key: And between this lush environment and the water below, I suspect there's no shortage of food here.
en: And between this lush environment and the water below, I suspect there's no shortage of food here.
ja: この豊かな環境と下にある水を考えると、ここには食べ物に不足はないはずだ。

key: Rather than desperately chasing after Victini, let's do our best to make ourselves worth approaching.
en: Rather than desperately chasing after Victini, let's do our best to make ourselves worth approaching.
ja: 必死にビクティニを追いかけるより、こちらに近づく価値があるようにしよう。

key: SERRA: You're going to lure it in with food?
en: SERRA: You're going to lure it in with food?
ja: セラ: 食べ物でおびき寄せるつもりなの?

key: BENNETT: It's the choicest course of action.
en: BENNETT: It's the choicest course of action.
ja: ベネット: それが最善の策だよ。

key: In a worst case scenario, we can all enjoy a nice meal together ourselves and come up with an alternative.
en: In a worst case scenario, we can all enjoy a nice meal together ourselves and come up with an alternative.
ja: 最悪の場合でも、みんなでおいしい食事を楽しみながら、別の案を考えればいい。

key: SERRA: ...Oh, fine.
en: SERRA: ...Oh, fine.
ja: セラ: …ああ、いいわ。

key: If we can find a pot, I'm sure I can whip something up.
en: If we can find a pot, I'm sure I can whip something up.
ja: 鍋さえ見つかれば、きっと何か作れると思うわ。

key: You don't get to be a single mother without learning to improvise a bit.
en: You don't get to be a single mother without learning to improvise a bit.
ja: シングルマザーをやってると、多少の即興くらい身につくものよ。

key: BENNETT: Our hiker left his spoon behind... With any luck, he'll have left his pot too.
en: BENNETT: Our hiker left his spoon behind... With any luck, he'll have left his pot too.
ja: ベネット: そのハイカーはスプーンを置いていった……運が良ければ、鍋も置いていったはずだ。

key: Mother, would you mind searching for that, or something equally usable?
en: Mother, would you mind searching for that, or something equally usable?
ja: 母上、それか同じくらい使えそうなものを、探していただけますか?

key: SERRA: That can't be sanitary.
en: SERRA: That can't be sanitary.
ja: セラ: それ、衛生的とは言えなさそうね。

key: But if and when I find it, I suppose the lake down there looks clean enough...
en: But if and when I find it, I suppose the lake down there looks clean enough...
ja: でも見つけたとして、下の湖はそこそこきれいそうだし……

key: BENNETT: I hear curries are quite popular with Pokémon in Galar...
en: BENNETT: I hear curries are quite popular with Pokémon in Galar...
ja: ベネット: ガラル地方では、ポケモンの間でカレーがかなり人気らしいね……

key: \PN, would you mind helping me gather some ingredients?
en: \PN, would you mind helping me gather some ingredients?
ja: \PN、材料を集めるのを手伝ってもらえるかな?

key: Considering the ecology here, I think most everything we need could be found in this very cave.
en: Considering the ecology here, I think most everything we need could be found in this very cave.
ja: この場所の生態系を考えると、必要なもののほとんどはこの洞窟の中で見つかると思う。

key: I have a rough list for what to look for. Talk to me when you're ready to hear it.
en: I have a rough list for what to look for. Talk to me when you're ready to hear it.
ja: 探すべきもののリストは大体できている。聞く準備ができたら話しかけてくれ。

key: BENNETT: I already had a chance to look around the area a bit, and I think I have a pretty good idea of what's available for us to use.
en: BENNETT: I already had a chance to look around the area a bit, and I think I have a pretty good idea of what's available for us to use.
ja: ベネット: すでにこの辺りを少し見て回ったから、何が使えるか大体把握できたと思う。

key: I believe our main course tonight will be...
en: I believe our main course tonight will be...
ja: 今夜のメインは……

key: Spiced Apple Galarian-style Curry.
en: Spiced Apple Galarian-style Curry.
ja: スパイスアップルの、ガラル風カレーだね。

key: BENNETT: How is it going?
en: BENNETT: How is it going?
ja: ベネット: 調子はどうかな?

key: BENNETT: Regarding the ingredients, I can give you a general idea for where they might be found.
en: BENNETT: Regarding the ingredients, I can give you a general idea for where they might be found.
ja: ベネット: 材料については、大体どこにありそうか教えられるよ。

key: For the apples-- both types-- I can see them both on the lower floor from here. Just above the water.
en: For the apples-- both types-- I can see them both on the lower floor from here. Just above the water.
ja: リンゴ――両方の種類とも――ここから見て下の階にあるのが見える。水のすぐ上だ。

key: The Rage Powder plants are directly across from me as well-- it looks as if those are on the lower level as well.
en: The Rage Powder plants are directly across from me as well-- it looks as if those are on the lower level as well.
ja: いかりのこなの植物も、俺の真向かいにある――そっちも下の階にあるようだね。

key: The Pecha Berry you'll find in the care of a wild Wurmple.
en: The Pecha Berry you'll find in the care of a wild Wurmple.
ja: モモンのみは、野生のケムッソが持っているのを見つけられるはずだ。

key: Wurmple frequently collect them, since it just so happens that the specific nutrients within Pecha Berries are perfect for creating beautiful cocoons, and--
en: Wurmple frequently collect them, since it just so happens that the specific nutrients within Pecha Berries are perfect for creating beautiful cocoons, and--
ja: ケムッソはよくそれを集めていてね、というのもモモンのみに含まれる特定の栄養素が、美しい繭を作るのにぴったりだからで――

key: ...Er, I suppose you don't care about the details.
en: ...Er, I suppose you don't care about the details.
ja: ……ああ、細かい話には興味ないよね。

key: Anyway, Wurmple characteristically inhabit a certain type of tree-- and I just so happen to recognize a grove of it on the west side of this level.
en: Anyway, Wurmple characteristically inhabit a certain type of tree-- and I just so happen to recognize a grove of it on the west side of this level.
ja: とにかく、ケムッソは特定の種類の木に住みつく習性があってね――ちょうどこの階の西側に、その木立を見つけたんだ。

key: The Stick-- which really should just be called a leek-- will be maintained by a Farfetch'd.
en: The Stick-- which really should just be called a leek-- will be maintained by a Farfetch'd.
ja: ながねぎ――正直、ただのネギと呼ぶべきものだが――はカモネギが管理しているはずだ。

key: I saw one flying about earlier-- but in this case, you'll have better luck searching for items on the ground rather than from wild Farfetch'd.
en: I saw one flying about earlier-- but in this case, you'll have better luck searching for items on the ground rather than from wild Farfetch'd.
ja: さっき一羽飛んでいるのを見たが――今回は、野生のカモネギから探すより、地面に落ちているアイテムを探した方が見込みがあるだろう。

key: I suspect it will have been left in a high place.
en: I suspect it will have been left in a high place.
ja: おそらく高い場所に残されているはずだ。

key: The Balm Mushroom will grow somewhere with lower light-- close to the ground, probably in a cave.
en: The Balm Mushroom will grow somewhere with lower light-- close to the ground, probably in a cave.
ja: かおるキノコは、光の少ない場所――地面に近く、おそらく洞窟の中に生えているはずだ。

key: Berry Juice is created naturally by Shuckle, and so you will always find it with one.
en: Berry Juice is created naturally by Shuckle, and so you will always find it with one.
ja: きのみジュースはツボツボが自然に作り出すものだから、必ずツボツボと一緒に見つかるはずだ。

key: Shuckle habitually hide under breaking rocks, and I suspect that this is the perfect habitat for them...
en: Shuckle habitually hide under breaking rocks, and I suspect that this is the perfect habitat for them...
ja: ツボツボは崩れる岩の下に隠れる習性があって、ここはそいつらにとって完璧な生息地だと思う……

key: Look for smashable rocks, and you will find a Shuckle-- and thus, the Berry Juice.
en: Look for smashable rocks, and you will find a Shuckle-- and thus, the Berry Juice.
ja: 壊せそうな岩を探せば、ツボツボが見つかるはずだ――そして、きのみジュースも。

key: That's everything that's left.
en: That's everything that's left.
ja: 残っているのはそれだけだ。

key: Feel free to ask again if you need a reminder.
en: Feel free to ask again if you need a reminder.
ja: また忘れたら、遠慮なく聞いてくれ。

key: BENNETT: I mentioned getting the Pecha Berries from Headbutt trees-- but more specifically, it'll be commonly held by the Wurmple living in those trees.
en: BENNETT: I mentioned getting the Pecha Berries from Headbutt trees-- but more specifically, it'll be commonly held by the Wurmple living in those trees.
ja: ベネット: モモンのみはずつきの木から手に入ると言ったが――もっと正確に言うと、その木に住んでいるケムッソがよく持っているんだ。

key: I know most Trainers don't just happen to have a Pokémon with Headbutt on them at all times though...
en: I know most Trainers don't just happen to have a Pokémon with Headbutt on them at all times though...
ja: とはいえ、大抵のトレーナーは常にずつきを覚えたポケモンを連れているわけじゃないよな……

key: If you need, I think I can prompt one of your Pokémon to learn the move here and now.
en: If you need, I think I can prompt one of your Pokémon to learn the move here and now.
ja: 必要なら、君のポケモンの一体に、今ここでその技を覚えさせられると思う。

key: Should we see about it?
en: Should we see about it?
ja: 試してみるかい?

key: BENNETT: Good luck.
en: BENNETT: Good luck.
ja: ベネット: 幸運を。

key: BENNETT: From this point, we'll need \v[614] things:
en: BENNETT: From this point, we'll need \v[614] things:
ja: ベネット: ここからは、\v[614]個のものが必要になる――

key: One Sweet Apple, for the main course.
en: One Sweet Apple, for the main course.
ja: メイン料理のために、あまーいりんごを1つ。

key: ...And I see you have it. Good work.
en: ...And I see you have it. Good work.
ja: ……ああ、持っているようだね。よくやった。

key: One Tart Apple, for substance and depth.
en: One Tart Apple, for substance and depth.
ja: コクと深みのために、すっぱいりんごを1つ。

key: ...And you've gotten it. Well done.
en: ...And you've gotten it. Well done.
ja: ……手に入れたんだね。よくやった。

key: One Balm Mushroom, for a second texture.
en: One Balm Mushroom, for a second texture.
ja: もうひとつの食感のために、かおるキノコを1つ。

key: You've got that. Excellent.
en: You've got that. Excellent.
ja: それも持っているね。素晴らしい。

key: One Pecha Berry, for the signature sweetness. Check the Headbutt trees for one.
en: One Pecha Berry, for the signature sweetness.  Check the Headbutt trees for one.
ja: 決め手の甘さのために、モモンのみを1つ。ずつきの木を確認してくれ。

key: You have the Pecha Berry. Im-pecha-ble.
en: You have the Pecha Berry. Im-pecha-ble.
ja: モモンのみを持っているね。パー・モモン・フェクトだ。

key: ...Sorry. Anyway...
en: ...Sorry. Anyway...
ja: ……すまない。とにかく……

key: Berry Juice, for sweetness and thinning.
en: Berry Juice, for sweetness and thinning.
ja: 甘みと伸ばしのために、きのみジュースを。

key: You have the Berry Juice. Wonderful.
en: You have the Berry Juice. Wonderful.
ja: きのみジュースを持っているね。素晴らしい。

key: A Farfetch'd's Stick. This leek will sauté into a perfect start, and the ends are a good garnish.
en: A Farfetch'd's Stick. This leek will sauté into a perfect start, and the ends are a good garnish.
ja: カモネギのながねぎ。このネギはいためれば申し分ない出だしになるし、端は良い彩りになる。

key: I see you have a Stick... Leek. Whatever. I'll take it.
en: I see you have a Stick... Leek. Whatever. I'll take it.
ja: ながねぎ……いやネギか。まあ、どっちでもいい。もらっておくよ。

key: Rage Powder. Properly treated, this powder stops having adverse effects and starts being a wonderful spice mix.
en: Rage Powder. Properly treated, this powder stops having adverse effects and starts being a wonderful spice mix.
ja: いかりのこな。ちゃんと処理すれば、この粉は悪影響をなくして、素晴らしいスパイスミックスになる。

key: And you've got it. Expectably reliable work.
en: And you've got it. Expectably reliable work.
ja: それも持っているね。期待通りの、頼りになる仕事ぶりだ。

key: ...That should be it.
en: ...That should be it.
ja: ……これで全部のはずだ。

key: If you want some hints on where to find everything, feel free to ask. I have a general idea for most things.
en: If you want some hints on where to find everything, feel free to ask. I have a general idea for most things.
ja: どこで見つかるかヒントが欲しければ、遠慮なく聞いてくれ。大体のものは把握しているから。

key: BENNETT: You got everything then.
en: BENNETT: You got everything then.
ja: ベネット: 全部そろったんだね。

key: Fantastic work as always, \PN.
en: Fantastic work as always, \PN.
ja: 相変わらず素晴らしい仕事ぶりだ、\PN。

key: SERRA: One pot of questionable cleanliness, ready to go as ordered.
en: SERRA: One pot of questionable cleanliness, ready to go as ordered.
ja: セラ: 清潔さに疑問符が付く鍋、ご注文通り用意できたわ。

key: BENNETT: We were fortunate to find everything we needed.
en: BENNETT: We were fortunate to find everything we needed.
ja: ベネット: 必要なものが全部見つかって、運が良かった。

key: Let's hope our fortune carries forward.
en: Let's hope our fortune carries forward.
ja: この運が続いてくれるといいね。

key: SERRA: I guess I'll get started with cooking.
en: SERRA: I guess I'll get started with cooking.
ja: セラ: それじゃ、料理を始めましょうか。

key: What all did you find?
en: What all did you find?
ja: 何を見つけてきたの?

key: BENNETT: Everything we need for Galarian-style Spiced Apple Curry.
en: BENNETT: Everything we need for Galarian-style Spiced Apple Curry.
ja: ベネット: ガラル風スパイスアップルカレーに必要なもの全部だよ。

key: SERRA: Curry! In a cave!
en: SERRA: Curry! In a cave!
ja: セラ: カレー!洞窟の中で!

key: Shall I prepare the other four courses as well?
en: Shall I prepare the other four courses as well?
ja: 残りの四品も用意しましょうか?

key: BENNETT: ...No,
en: BENNETT: ...No,
ja: ベネット: ……いや、

key: In fact, why don't you leave the cooking to me?
en: In fact, why don't you leave the cooking to me?
ja: むしろ、料理は俺に任せてもらえないかな?

key: SERRA: Oh, please. What would you know about cooking?
en: SERRA: Oh, please. What would you know about cooking?
ja: セラ: あら、やめてよ。あなたが料理について何を知ってるっていうの?

key: You've never prepared so much as microwaveable Hot Pokétt for yourself.
en: You've never prepared so much as microwaveable Hot Pokétt for yourself.
ja: レンジで温めるだけのホットポケットひとつ、自分で用意したことすらないでしょう。

key: BENNETT: Not under your roof.
en: BENNETT: Not under your roof.
ja: ベネット: 母上の屋根の下では、な。

key: But I've learned much in my time away, including how to care for myself.
en: But I've learned much in my time away, including how to care for myself.
ja: でも家を出てからの間に、自分の面倒の見方も含めて、多くを学んだんだ。

key: I would enjoy a chance to demonstrate as much.
en: I would enjoy a chance to demonstrate as much.
ja: その成果を見せる機会を、楽しませてもらいたいところだよ。

key: SERRA: Well... We could try to do it together.
en: SERRA: Well... We could try to do it together.
ja: セラ: そうね……一緒にやってみましょうか。

key: As equals?
en: As equals?
ja: 対等な立場で?

key: BENNETT: As equals, then.
en: BENNETT: As equals, then.
ja: ベネット: それなら、対等な立場で。

key: Would you mind skinning the apples?
en: Would you mind skinning the apples?
ja: リンゴの皮むきをお願いできるかな?

key: Volcarona can get the fire going.
en: Volcarona can get the fire going.
ja: ウルガモスに火を起こしてもらえる。

key: \PN, you've done enough. Have a seat and relax.
en: \PN, you've done enough. Have a seat and relax.
ja: \PN、君は十分やってくれた。座ってゆっくりしてくれ。

key: The rest of this meal will be on us.
en: The rest of this meal will be on us.
ja: 残りの調理は俺たちに任せてくれ。

key: A hole in the ground shoots directly below.
en: A hole in the ground shoots directly below.
ja: 地面の穴は、真下へとつながっているようだ。

key: Jump?
en: Jump?
ja: 飛び込みますか?

key: SERRA: Well, it should be done any minute.
en: SERRA: Well, it should be done any minute.
ja: セラ: さて、もうすぐ出来上がるはずよ。

key: BENNETT: Nearly. I'll sprinkle it with the rest of the powder for an extra kick.
en: BENNETT: Nearly. I'll sprinkle it with the rest of the powder for an extra kick.
ja: ベネット: もう少しだ。仕上げに残りの粉を振りかけて、パンチを加えよう。

key: And garnish with the greens, and... voilà.
en: And garnish with the greens, and... voilà.
ja: それから野菜を添えて……ほら、できた。

key: SERRA: Your presentation is certainly better than mine ever was...
en: SERRA: Your presentation is certainly better than mine ever was...
ja: セラ: あなたの盛り付け、わたしのよりよっぽど上手ね……

key: BENNETT: They say presentation is half the appeal. I'm sure you would know that from your work.
en: BENNETT: They say presentation is half the appeal.  I'm sure you would know that from your work.
ja: ベネット: 盛り付けは魅力の半分だと言うからね。母上なら仕事柄よくご存知のはずだ。

key: But it is not the half that matters. How is the taste?
en: But it is not the half that matters. How is the taste?
ja: でも大事なのはそっちの半分じゃない。味はどうだい?

key: SERRA: ...
en: SERRA: ...
ja: セラ: ……

key: For cave-made curry, it's not bad.
en: For cave-made curry, it's not bad.
ja: 洞窟で作ったカレーにしては、悪くないわね。

key: BENNETT: Sweet and spicy is a classic mix. The key is balancing it properly.
en: BENNETT: Sweet and spicy is a classic mix. The key is balancing it properly.
ja: ベネット: 甘さと辛さは定番の組み合わせだ。大事なのは、うまくバランスを取ることだよ。

key: SERRA: In fact, if you told me this was from the Spyce, I might even believe you.
en: SERRA: In fact, if you told me this was from the Spyce, I might even believe you.
ja: セラ: 正直、これがスパイスの店のものだって言われても、信じてしまいそうだわ。

key: BENNETT: Your praise is appreciated. As was your help in making it.
en: BENNETT: Your praise is appreciated. As was your help in making it.
ja: ベネット: 褒めてもらえてうれしいよ。作るのを手伝ってくれたこともね。

key: That goes for both of you.
en: That goes for both of you.
ja: それは二人とも、だよ。

key: BENNETT: Hello up there, little one.
en: BENNETT: Hello up there, little one.
ja: ベネット: やあ、そこの小さいの。

key: Interested in a bite?
en: Interested in a bite?
ja: 一口、興味あるかい?

key: There's plenty to go around.
en: There's plenty to go around.
ja: たっぷりあるからね。

key: BENNETT: See, there's nothing to fear.
en: BENNETT: See, there's nothing to fear.
ja: ベネット: ほら、何も怖がることはないよ。

key: Here, allow me to serve you.
en: Here, allow me to serve you.
ja: さあ、よそってあげよう。

key: BENNETT: Well, someone certainly seems to be energetic after their dinner.
en: BENNETT: Well, someone certainly seems to be energetic after their dinner.
ja: ベネット: おや、夕食を食べて元気いっぱいのようだね。

key: SERRA: Is this the part where our wholesome family meal devolves into violence?
en: SERRA: Is this the part where our wholesome family meal devolves into violence?
ja: セラ: これって、健全な家族の食事が暴力に発展する場面かしら?

key: BENNETT: Sporting violence only.
en: BENNETT: Sporting violence only.
ja: ベネット: スポーツとしての暴力だけだよ。

key: I do believe our little friend here is ready to burn some energy.
en: I do believe our little friend here is ready to burn some energy.
ja: この小さな友達、エネルギーを発散したくてたまらないようだ。

key: \PN, this is usually your prerogative, isn't it?
en: \PN, this is usually your prerogative, isn't it?
ja: \PN、これは普段、君の特権のはずだよね?

key: SERRA: You're just handing it off to \PN?
en: SERRA: You're just handing it off to \PN?
ja: セラ: \PNに丸投げするつもり?

key: Didn't you pick up Fire types for your Elite position?
en: Didn't you pick up Fire types for your Elite position?
ja: エリートの座のために、ほのおタイプをそろえたんじゃなかったの?

key: BENNETT: My priority here was just making sure Anomalies were contained, and this little guy doesn't seem to be attached to one.
en: BENNETT: My priority here was just making sure Anomalies were contained, and this little guy doesn't seem to be attached to one.
ja: ベネット: ここでの俺の優先事項は、アノマリーが確実に封じ込められることだけだった。この子には特についていないようだしね。

key: There will be other opportunities for me anyway.
en: There will be other opportunities for me anyway.
ja: 俺にはどのみち、他の機会もあるだろうし。

key: The floor is yours as you wish, \PN.
en: The floor is yours as you wish, \PN.
ja: 望むなら、この場は君に譲るよ、\PN。

key: BENNETT: This one's all yours.
en: BENNETT: This one's all yours.
ja: ベネット: こいつは全部君のものだ。

key: I'm sure you can give it an appropriately enjoyable fight.
en: I'm sure you can give it an appropriately enjoyable fight.
ja: きっと、ふさわしく楽しい戦いをさせてあげられるはずだ。

key: BENNETT: So that's that.
en: BENNETT: So that's that.
ja: ベネット: さて、これで終わりだ。

key: SERRA: Well, I appreciate you having me along.
en: SERRA: Well, I appreciate you having me along.
ja: セラ: それにしても、連れてきてくれてありがとう。

key: Even if I didn't do anything.
en: Even if I didn't do anything.
ja: 何もしなかったとしても、だけど。

key: BENNETT: You did help with the kitchenware and cooking. There's no need to put your own efforts aside.
en: BENNETT: You did help with the kitchenware and cooking. There's no need to put your own efforts aside.
ja: ベネット: 調理器具のことも料理のことも、ちゃんと手伝ってくれたじゃないか。自分の努力を軽く見る必要はないよ。

key: "Equals" includes treating yourself with respect as well.
en: "Equals" includes treating yourself with respect as well.
ja: 「対等」というのは、自分自身を敬うことも含まれるんだ。

key: SERRA: ...Oh,
en: SERRA: ...Oh,
ja: セラ: …あら、

key: Well, that's not a lesson I should have to learn from my own child...
en: Well, that's not a lesson I should have to learn from my own child...
ja: それにしても、自分の子供から教わるようなことじゃないと思うのだけれど……

key: ... But from someone who's my equal, I guess it's okay.
en: ... But from someone who's my equal, I guess it's okay.
ja: ……でも、対等な相手からなら、まあ、いいのかもしれないわね。

key: BENNETT: Everyone needs a reminder from time to time.
en: BENNETT: Everyone needs a reminder from time to time.
ja: ベネット: 誰だって、時々思い出させてもらう必要があるものさ。

key: For now, shall we be off?
en: For now, shall we be off?
ja: さて、そろそろ行こうか。

key: SERRA: I think so.
en: SERRA: I think so.
ja: セラ: そうね。

key: I have a long night of staring into the middle distance and contemplating my own flawed perspective planned.
en: I have a long night of staring into the middle distance and contemplating my own flawed perspective planned.
ja: 今夜は、遠くをぼんやり見つめながら、自分のゆがんだものの見方についてじっくり考える長い夜を過ごすつもりよ。

key: BENNETT: As long as you're contemplating improving it.
en: BENNETT: As long as you're contemplating improving it.
ja: ベネット: 改善しようと考えているなら、それでいいさ。

key: \PN, would you like to walk back with us?
en: \PN, would you like to walk back with us?
ja: \PN、一緒に戻らないかい?

key: BENNETT: Then let's be off.
en: BENNETT: Then let's be off.
ja: ベネット: それじゃあ、行こう。

key: BENNETT: I can't blame you for wanting to look around more.
en: BENNETT: I can't blame you for wanting to look around more.
ja: ベネット: もっと見て回りたいという気持ちはよくわかるよ。

key: This is really quite an interesting environment we've stumbled onto here.
en: This is really quite an interesting environment we've stumbled onto here.
ja: ここは本当に、偶然出会ったにしては興味深い環境だ。

key: I'd be interested in learning exactly how the local ecosystem maintains temperature and stability despite...
en: I'd be interested in learning exactly how the local ecosystem maintains temperature and stability despite...
ja: この地域の生態系が、これほどの状況にもかかわらず、どうやって気温と安定性を保っているのか、正確に知りたいところだけど……

key: Uh, well, not to bore you... Let's just say "I think it's neat," and leave it at that.
en: Uh, well, not to bore you... Let's just say "I think it's neat," and leave it at that.
ja: ああ、いや、退屈させたくはないな……「なかなか面白い」ってことにして、それだけにしておこう。

key: Until next time, \PN.
en: Until next time, \PN.
ja: また今度な、\PN。

key: SERRA: So now we've got dinner, and a show to go with it.
en: SERRA: So now we've got dinner, and a show to go with it.
ja: セラ: これで夕食と、それに添えるショーまで手に入ったわね。

key: This is almost better than most of the actual dates I've been on.
en: This is almost better than most of the actual dates I've been on.
ja: これ、わたしが今までしてきた大抵のデートより、よっぽど良いくらいだわ。

key: VICTINI: Ti-ti-ti-ti-ti-ti-ni!!!
en: VICTINI: Ti-ti-ti-ti-ti-ti-ni!!!
ja: ビクティニ: ティティティティティニ!!!

ja: 材料集めをスキップしますか?

ja: \PNは、いかりのこなを手に入れた!
